entities.summary: Christine Swane née Christine Larsen was a Danish painter who first associated with the Funen Painters before developing her own increasingly Cubist style. Christine Swane was a painters & sculptors from Kerteminde (1876-05-29, Kerteminde–1960-08-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
